name: XnView MP
price: Free for private/educational/non-profit use; commercial license 29 EUR (volume tiers down to 3.90 EUR)
engine: Qt 6; video via MDK SDK (FFmpeg based); LibRaw, libheif, libarchive
summary: XnView MP is a long-running cross-platform image browser and organizer that reads more than 500 formats. It combines a file browser, viewer, catalog with categories and ratings, batch converter and basic editor in one app. On the Mac it is a Qt app, free for private use.
where_it_wins: More than 500 image formats, export to about 70
Batch convert and batch rename with regex
Catalog with categories, ratings and color labels
Image editing, compare up to 4 images, duplicate finder
Runs on Windows and Linux too
where_schnellbild_wins: Free and open source for everyone, including companies
Native Mac app in Apple's App Sandbox without network access
Video player with subtitles, audio tracks, speed and a movable control bar; skim videos with arrow keys
Two-pane file manager with F5/F6 and undo for file actions
Archives incl. passwords and multi-part play videos straight from inside
Slideshow through all subfolders mixing photos and videos, with a playlist on the fly
Keyboard first, with a printable cheat sheet

free.note: Free for private, educational and non-profit use; companies need a license (29 EUR single seat).

native_apple_silicon.note: Developer: 'Mac Intel or Arm is supported'. Release posts still label the single Mac DMG 'x64'.

no_account_no_tracking.note: Vendor states 'NO Adware, NO Spyware'; no account needed.

dark_light_setting.note: Own themes incl. dark theme, switchable in settings.

folder_browsing.note: Built-in file browser with folder tree.

recursive_search.note: Advanced File Search (pathname, metadata, categories); 'Show files in subfolders'.

regex_search.note: Regex only in Batch Rename; file search uses wildcards / contains.

network_shares_fast.note: Works on SMB/UNC, but changelog lists hangs/slowness on UNC paths, network shares and many subfolders.

img_svg_pdf.note: PDF listed; SVG supported (changelog SVG fixes).

img_animated.note: GIF, APNG, animated WebP and AVIF.

slideshow_recursive.note: Slideshow waits for videos to end (fix 0000646); 'show files in subfolders' feeds it. Mixed run through all subfolders not described as one feature.

auto_enhance_view.note: Auto Levels/Contrast and adjustments are edit tools (file changes when saved), not a view-only filter.

file_info_exif.note: EXIF/IPTC/XMP panels, histogram; video info in thumbnail labels.

wrong_extension_note.note: Files with a wrong extension are opened (changelog fixes), but no note: an open suggestion asks for a hint or auto-rename.

video_mkv_avi_webm.note: FAQ: MP4, MOV, AVI, MKV, WebM and most FFmpeg containers.

photos_videos_one_grid.note: Video thumbnails in the browser next to images.

video_skim_arrows.note: Not found in the changelog or forum searches.

subtitles_embedded.note: Full changelog of the MDK-based player has no subtitle entry; forum search finds no MP subtitle feature.

subtitles_external_files.note: No subtitle support in the full changelog.

audio_track_choice.note: No audio track entry in the full changelog.

playback_speed.note: Open suggestion 'Video Playback Speed Options' (2022); no speed entry in the changelog.

control_bar_movable.note: Not described in docs, changelog or forum.

playlist.note: No playlist entry in the full changelog; videos play from the browser or slideshow.

saved_playlists.note: Slideshows can be saved as .sld files (images, with audio).

pip.note: No Picture in Picture in the full changelog.

music_mode.note: 'Multimedia Player' listed; audio companion files; no music library.

streaming_urls.note: Plays local files only; no stream/URL playback in the changelog.

video_filters_enhance.note: Adjustments apply to images; no video adjustment entry in the changelog.

quicklook_mkv_thumbnails.note: No Quick Look extension in the changelog; XnShell is Windows-only.

archives_as_folders.note: ZIP, RAR, CAB, 7-Zip browsable via LibArchive; changelog shows recurring archive bugs.

comics_cbz_cbr.note: Developer: cbz/cbr are in the archive extension list.

archive_passwords.note: Archives via libarchive/unrar; no password entry in the changelog; only an old Classic suggestion asks for it.

split_archives.note: Not mentioned in changelog or forum.

videos_in_archives.note: Not mentioned in changelog or forum.

manga_two_page.note: CBZ/CBR shown as archives; no two-page or right-to-left mode in the changelog.

rename_trash.note: Rename, batch rename, delete to trash in browser.

move_copy.note: Move/copy incl. drag and drop into folders.

dual_pane.note: Compare up to 4 images; F6 cycles browser panels; no two-folder file-manager mode.

undo_file_actions.note: Open suggestion 'Do we have a move undo?' (2018-2019); undo exists for edits/paint only.

image_editing.note: Resize, crop, rotate, adjust, filters, paint.

batch_convert.note: Batch convert (~70 output formats), batch rename.

library_catalog.note: Catalog database, categories, ratings, color labels.

cloud_sync.note: Has a web upload function; no cloud sync.

keyboard_first.note: Many configurable shortcuts; whether everything works without the mouse is not documented.

shortcut_cheatsheet.note: Users ask for a list of all shortcuts; pre-assigned F-keys are not even listed in Settings → Shortcuts.

boss_key.note: Suggestion thread 'boss key'; answer recommends an external tool.

app_sandbox.note: Direct download outside the Mac App Store; entitlements not documented.

no_network.note: Has a 'Check for update' function and web upload.

notarized_attested.note: Closed source, so no build from public source; notarization not verified.

mac_app_store.note: Not in the Mac App Store (only XnRetro is).
